name: jira_search_issues
description: Search Jira issues with a JQL query (by assignee, status, project, dates). Returns a list of issues with key, summary and status.

name: jira_get_issue
description: Get full details of one Jira issue by its key, including description and comments.

name: jira_create_issue
description: Create a new Jira issue in a project with a summary, description and type.

name: jira_transition_issue
description: Change the status of a Jira issue, for example move it to In Progress or Done.

name: slack_post_message
description: Post a message to a Slack channel.

name: slack_send_dm
description: Send a direct message to one Slack user.

name: slack_search_messages
description: Search Slack messages by text, channel, author or date.

name: slack_list_channels
description: List Slack channels available in the workspace.

name: github_create_issue
description: Create an issue in a GitHub repository.

name: github_search_issues
description: Search GitHub issues and pull requests by text, label, author or state.

name: github_create_pull_request
description: Open a pull request from one branch to another in a GitHub repository.

name: github_get_file_contents
description: Read the contents of a file from a GitHub repository at a given branch or commit.

name: gdrive_search_files
description: Search Google Drive files by name or content.

name: gdrive_read_file
description: Read the text contents of a Google Drive file by its id.

name: gdrive_create_document
description: Create a new Google Docs document with the given title and text.

name: postgres_list_tables
description: List tables and their columns in the connected PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_run_query
description: Run a read-only SQL query on the connected PostgreSQL database and return the rows.

name: postgres_explain_query
description: Show the execution plan of an SQL query to analyze its performance.
